column2: Number of bits of a DL-SCH transport block received within a TTI for normal/special sub-frame

column1: Note 1:For 2 layer transmissions, 2 transport blocks are received within a TTI.Note 2:71112 bits for sub-frame 5.Note 3:The TB success rate is defined as TB success rate = 100%*NDL_correct_rx/ (NDL_newtx + NDL_retx), where NDL_newtx is the number of newly transmitted DL transport blocks, NDL_retx is the number of retransmitted DL transport blocks, and NDL_correct_rx is the number of correctly received DL transport blocks.
